optional-value-handling.title: Represent optional values with Optional
optional-value-handling.short: Make the possible absence of a value explicit
optional-value-handling.summary: Use Optional to represent a return value that may be absent.
optional-value-handling.why: Optional makes presence and absence explicit in an API and asks callers to decide how an absent value should be handled.
optional-value-handling.tips: Do not apply it mechanically to fields and parameters; it is most useful for return values that may legitimately be absent.

try-with-resources.title: Close resources with try-with-resources
try-with-resources.short: Reliably close files and other resources after use
try-with-resources.why: Resources opened in a try-with-resources header are closed automatically on both normal completion and exceptional exits.
try-with-resources.tips: Prefer it for Reader, Stream, Connection, and other AutoCloseable resources.

map-compute-if-absent.title: Create a Map value when absent
map-compute-if-absent.short: Combine initialization and lookup with computeIfAbsent
map-compute-if-absent.summary: Generate a Map value only when the key has no value.
map-compute-if-absent.why: computeIfAbsent combines the common contains-check, construction, put, and retrieval pattern into one operation.
map-compute-if-absent.tips: Keep the mapping function free of heavy side effects, and be careful about assumptions on invocation counts with concurrent maps.

string-lines-stream.title: Process a String line by line
string-lines-stream.short: Use String.lines to obtain a Stream of lines
string-lines-stream.summary: Process multiline text as a Stream.
string-lines-stream.why: String.lines() returns the lines of a string as a Stream that can feed directly into filter, map, and other operations.
string-lines-stream.tips: When you do not need an array containing every line, this can be more natural than split.

index-out-of-bounds-list.title: IndexOutOfBoundsException with List
index-out-of-bounds-list.short: An index outside the List range was accessed
index-out-of-bounds-list.summary: Check the valid index range of a List.
index-out-of-bounds-list.why: For a List with size elements, valid indexes run from 0 through size-1. Calling get(size) is out of range.
index-out-of-bounds-list.tips: The last index is size()-1, and even that is invalid for an empty List, so check isEmpty when needed.

unsupported-operation-fixed-list.title: UnsupportedOperationException on an unmodifiable List
unsupported-operation-fixed-list.short: Tried to add to a List that cannot be modified
unsupported-operation-fixed-list.summary: Avoid update operations on unmodifiable collections.
unsupported-operation-fixed-list.why: Lists returned by List.of and similar factories are unmodifiable, so add and remove operations throw UnsupportedOperationException.
unsupported-operation-fixed-list.tips: If mutation is required, create a mutable copy such as new ArrayList<>(source).

missing-return-value.title: A code path does not return a value
missing-return-value.short: A non-void method can finish without return
missing-return-value.summary: Return a value on every reachable normal path.
missing-return-value.why: A non-void method must produce a return value on every path that can complete normally.
missing-return-value.tips: Check each branch for return, or place a common return after the conditional branches.

lambda-variable-not-effectively-final.title: Lambda local variable is not effectively final
lambda-variable-not-effectively-final.short: Tried to modify a local variable captured by a lambda
lambda-variable-not-effectively-final.summary: Understand the restriction on local variables captured by lambdas.
lambda-variable-not-effectively-final.why: A local variable referenced from a lambda must be final or effectively final, so the lambda cannot reassign it.
lambda-variable-not-effectively-final.tips: For aggregation, operations such as Stream.count or reduce often avoid shared mutable state entirely.

varargs-heap-pollution-warning.title: Heap pollution warning with generic varargs
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.short: Generic arrays and varargs can undermine type safety
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.summary: Handle warnings caused by varargs of non-reifiable types.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.why: Generic varargs use arrays internally, and the combination of type erasure with runtime array checks can permit heap pollution.
varargs-heap-pollution-warning.tips: Prefer a collection parameter when possible, and consider @SafeVarargs only when the implementation is demonstrably safe.

off-by-one-loop-bound.title: Off-by-one loop bound
off-by-one-loop-bound.short: Using <= instead of < performs one extra iteration
off-by-one-loop-bound.summary: Prevent one-step errors in indexed loop bounds.
off-by-one-loop-bound.why: For a zero-based sequence of size elements, the final valid index is size-1, so the usual loop condition is i < size.
off-by-one-loop-bound.tips: If the index itself is unnecessary, an enhanced for loop removes the boundary condition entirely.
